Exposed source, staged-candidate, executive presentation, and relationship-subject identities as separate governed read-model values.
Reconciled independent source Relationship endpoints with query and rendered exact business-object ID sets.

BT Group shows source ENT-BT, presentation bt-group, 1 Programme, and 3 Opportunities.
All six Enterprises reconcile while 17 Opportunities, 13 Programmes, factual isolation, and candidate governance remain protected.
unchanged_areas: Archive and manifest ingestion, validation, candidate creation, relationship resolver, TEL-001 fixture, Canonical Factual Projection, promotion, review, assessment, recommendation, and Observation architecture remain unchanged.

Open all six TEL-001 Enterprise presentation routes and reconcile canonical identities and exact association IDs.
Confirm BT excludes PROG-BT-VERIZON-JV and includes OPP-BT-VERIZON-JV-INTEGRATION.
Confirm Programme and Opportunity populations remain 13 and 17.
fresh_import_policy: No fresh import is required: staging already persists original_source_id; the correction exposes that retained lineage in the read-model constructor.

Financial Position diagnostic/presentation disagreement remains out of scope.
